distilled_patterns.description: Multi-hop browsing cases frequently exhaust turn budgets before resolving all intermediary facts, triggering premature termination under hard step limits and forcing unverified fallback submissions.
distilled_patterns.effect: Prevents step-exhaustion failures on 3 cases. Increase the maximum step limit in D4 and adjust the stop rule to prioritize evidence grounding over early budget convergence.

distilled_patterns.description: Across multiple browsecomp_plus cases, the agent repeatedly includes explanatory narratives, reasoning preambles, and conversational text within the final answer submission instead of submitting only the isolated entity, causing post-processing and verification validation checks to fail.
distilled_patterns.effect: Causes 0.0 reward across 8 cases due to strict string matching failures. Update D6 postprocess to an active entity-extraction parser (e.g., regex/schema extraction) and enforce strict single-token/entity verification.

distilled_patterns.description: The retrieval workflow relies on overly rigid keyword queries and fails to systematically fetch and inspect candidate documents, leading to budget depletion before locating the necessary factual evidence.
distilled_patterns.effect: Agents exhaust step limits and submit ungrounded fallback guesses. Configure D2 with iterative query expansion and automatic snippet ranking, while increasing D4 step budgets for complex browse trajectories.

distilled_patterns.description: Agents consistently contaminate final answer calls with explanatory prose, preambles, and conversational narrative rather than pure entities. distilled_patterns.effect: Eliminates repeated zero-reward evaluations across 8 cases. Upgrade D6 postprocess to regex_entity_cleaner or llm_extractor, and configure the validator to enforce strict isolated token matching.

distilled_patterns.description: The search strategy relies on exhaustive keyword variations and narrow term reformulation rather than fetching and inspecting document contents. distilled_patterns.effect: Prevents search-loop budget exhaustion in 5 cases. Shift D2 retrieval_mode to forced_fetch_and_parse with explicit page extraction depth, capping search queries before mandatory inspection.
